in_hebrew.name: Quiteria
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Quiteria הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'quietus' meaning 'rest', 'peace'. In Christian tradition, Quiteria may symbolize a calm and serene spirit.

in_greek.name: Quiteria
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Quiet, Restful
in_greek.long_meaning: Quiteria είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Latin word 'quietus' meaning 'rest', 'peace'. In Christian tradition, Quiteria may symbolize a calm and serene spirit.

in_latin.name: Quiteria
in_latin.meaning: Quiteria, feminine given name, derived from Latin and possibly related to 'quiet' or 'still'
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen femininum Latinum, putativus origo a 'quietus' vel 'stillus', nomen Christianum, nominum in usu a saeculis, etymologia incerta, sed possibilia cognatio cum 'quietus' vel 'stillus', significans pacem et tranquillitatem mentis, in usu a saeculis in Ecclesia Christiana, nomen sanctum, significans virtutes et bonitas
